# Excalidraw Utilities

This layer contains utility functions and classes used for exporting and manipulating shapes in the software project.

## Overview

It includes functions for exporting scenes and manipulating geometric shapes.

## Responsibilities

- **Manipulating Shapes**: Classes and functions for creating and manipulating geometric shapes.

## Documents in this part

<!-- docturnal:subdocs -->
- [Tests](excalidraw-utilities/tests.md): Contains test files for various utility functions and components in the project.
<!-- /docturnal:subdocs -->

## Key components

| File | Purpose | Main definitions |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`packages/utils/src/index.ts`](../../packages/utils/src/index.ts) | Exports utility functions for exporting and manipulating shapes. | `exportScene`, `exportToClipboard`, `MIME_TYPES`, `ExportSceneData`, `ExportSceneConfig`, `ExportSceneOptions` |
| [`packages/utils/src/shape.ts`](../../packages/utils/src/shape.ts) | Exports utility classes for geometric shapes. | `Polyline`, `Polycurve`, `Ellipse`, `GeometricShape`, `getPolygonShape`, `getSelectionBoxShape` |
| [`packages/utils/src/test-utils.ts`](../../packages/utils/src/test-utils.ts) | Provides utility functions for testing. |  |

## How it works

The `index.ts` file exports functions for exporting scenes and manipulating shapes, while the `shape.ts` file exports utility classes for geometric shapes. The `test-utils.ts` file provides utility functions for testing components and functions within the layer.

- Configuration files: `packages/utils/tsconfig.json`.
